packageRules.description: Everything except the desktop's Material stack: detect and list on the Dependency Dashboard, open a PR only when ticked there
Moved by the Material port (.github/upstream-port.md) to what gpui-kit-material requires
gpui-kit-material releases: one PR on a fixed branch, which upstream-port.yml hands to Claude Code
prBodyNotes: The **Upstream port** workflow moves the desktop client to this release with Claude Code and pushes the result here. When every check passes it labels the PR `port-ready`; **Upstream land** then merges it once CI is green.
